Write the LANDIS-II v8 initial communities CSV file

Source: R/vri_to_ic.R
CreateInitialCommunitiesCSVFile.Rd

Non-vegetated map codes (< 10000) are omitted; LANDIS-II v8 treats absent map codes as empty communities. CohortBiomass is always 0 (initial biomass is derived from cohort age during succession initialisation).

Usage

CreateInitialCommunitiesCSVFile(
  InitialCommunitiesDataList,
  dicCleanMapCodes,
  InitialCommunitiesCSV
)

Arguments

InitialCommunitiesDataList

data.frame with columns MapCode, SpeciesCode, Age.

dicCleanMapCodes

Named list from CleanMapCodes().

InitialCommunitiesCSV

Output file path for the CSV.

Value

Invisibly NULL (writes to file as a side effect).
